about.body: The AJ-V8 is a Inline-6 (I6), 3.0L (2,997 cc), Diesel, Diesel MHEV engine used across Land Rover's 5 model range, in production 2019–present. We rebuild every AJ-V8 to original specification, replacing worn timing components, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.

byModel.body: The AJ-V8 is fitted across Defender, Discovery, Range Rover, Range Rover Sport, Range Rover Velar — see the full applications table above for exact variants, generations and years.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ-V8 is fitted across multiple Land Rover models, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation and specification. We confirm by registration or VIN before quoting or supplying anything.
